grammarFocus: have to / must / can；一般现在时与过去时对比。
title: Lin Mei's Busy Week at the Supermarket
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。短文和问题都是模拟材料，不是官方考试。请根据短文内容选择或填写答案。
passage:
Lin Mei works at a small supermarket. She is an assistant manager. She has to start work at 8 a.m. every day. She must check the fruit and vegetables first. She can take a short break at 10 a.m. She usually works five days a week, from Monday to Friday. She likes her job because she can meet many people.

Last week was very busy. On Monday, she had to count all the boxes. There were 120 boxes. On Tuesday, she had to clean the big fridge, but she forgot. Mr. Chen, the manager, was not happy because the fridge was dirty. On Wednesday, she had to help a new worker. She showed him how to use the computer. On Thursday, she had to order more milk and bread. She called the supplier. On Friday, she had to check every bill. She finished at 7 p.m. She was very tired.

This week is different. Lin Mei must train two new workers. She can use the computer room for training. She has to write a report for Mr. Chen every Friday. She must not be late. She can leave early on Wednesday because she has a doctor's appointment. On Thursday, she will have a meeting with Mr. Chen to talk about the new workers.

Lin Mei likes her job. She says, "I have to work hard, but I can learn new things."

grammar.title: have to / must / can 与一般现在时和过去时对比
grammar.explanation: 在英语中，我们用 have to 和 must 表示“必须、不得不”，用 can 表示“可以、能够”。have to 强调客观需要，must 强调主观义务，can 表示允许或能力。一般现在时描述现在的习惯或事实，一般过去时描述过去发生的事情。注意：在过去时中，have to 要变成 had to，must 没有过去式，通常用 had to 代替。
grammar.example: On Tuesday, she had to clean the big fridge, but she forgot.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence for a past obligation.
options: Yesterday, I must finish the report.
Yesterday, I had to finish the report.
Yesterday, I have to finish the report.
Yesterday, I can finish the report.
answers: Yesterday, I had to finish the report.
questions.explanation: 过去时中表示“不得不”用 had to，不能用 must 或 have to。
questions.evidence: On Tuesday, she had to clean the big fridge, but she forgot.

questions.prompt: Which sentence talks about a present ability?
options: She can use the computer room.
She could use the computer room.
She had to use the computer room.
She must use the computer room.
answers: She can use the computer room.
questions.explanation: can 表示现在的能力或许可，could 是过去式，had to 和 must 表示必须。
questions.evidence: She can use the computer room for training.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence for a present obligation.
options: Every day, she had to start at 8 a.m.
Every day, she must start at 8 a.m.
Every day, she can start at 8 a.m.
Every day, she started at 8 a.m.
answers: Every day, she must start at 8 a.m.
questions.explanation: 一般现在时表示现在的义务，用 must 或 has to。had to 是过去时。
questions.evidence: She has to start work at 8 a.m. every day.

questions.prompt: Which sentence is about a past obligation?
options: She has to write a report every Friday.
She had to check every bill last Friday.
She can leave early on Wednesday.
answers: She had to check every bill last Friday.
questions.explanation: last Friday 表示过去，用 had to 表示过去的义务。
questions.evidence: On Friday, she had to check every bill.
